benchmark: Interview recovers the truth: degraded spec -> Nano compile -> Super interview against a deterministic oracle

passes.main: Nano and Super thinking off (enable_thinking=false), Super max_tokens 1200, Nano 3000; 3 runs per spec
passes.thinking: Super thinking on (default), max_tokens 6000; Nano unchanged; 1 run per spec
passes.compile-v2: ablation: compile prompt also asks for a missing via point and missing preconditions; otherwise as main; 3 runs per spec
passes.v2-changes-first: ablation: compile-v2 + the interview returns changes[] before the next question (key order)
passes.v2-split: ablation: compile-v2 + a separate Super call turns each answer into changes (CONVERT_SYSTEM), then the spec is patched and recompiled, then the next question is asked from fresh slots; the asking call's changes are ignored

conditions.turn: turn k = the spec after the answer to question k was applied and recompiled; turn 0 = the degraded spec; an interview that stops early carries its last value forward
conditions.degrade: five fields of step s2 per spec: fit (pocket clearance, or the tolerance band for zone/stack), aperture (size_mm scaled x1.7 or x0.6, confidence 0.3, plus one open question), success, via_points, preconditions; files in bench/specs/interview/degraded/
conditions.oracle: classifies each question into fit, aperture, success, via, precondition or other from the slot Super names and from keywords in the question's interrogative clause (either may point at a removed field; step-level fields count only on s2, size only on the manipulated object; see classify()); answers from the ground-truth spec with a templated sentence when it is about a removed field (also when that field was already recovered: counted as a repeat), else 'I don't know.' (counted as wasted)

checks.fit: pocket: |clearance - truth| <= max(0.5 mm, 25%); zone/stack: every truth axis in steps[s2].tolerances within max(2, 25%)
checks.aperture: grasped width (cylinder diameter; box min(x, y)) within max(2 mm, 20%)
checks.success: every truth predicate kind present in steps[s2].success, its value (when it has one) within max(1, 20%); extra predicates allowed
checks.via: some steps[s2].via_points entry in the fixture's frame with z within max(10 mm, 20%) of the truth (or in world with z within that of fixture z + truth z)
checks.precondition: every truth predicate kind present in steps[s2].preconditions, value within max(1, 20%); extra predicates allowed

conditions.apply: lib/spec/apply.ts applyChanges (atomic batch, schema-validated): a batch with one bad change applies nothing
conditions.prices: list prices from tests/fixtures/models.json (Super $0.30 / $0.90, Nano $0.06 / $0.24 per million)
